formats.key: addListing(uint256 tokenId, address token, uint256 price, uint40 expires)
effects: Creates a standing sell order: anyone can buy the signer's pFT NFT tokenId for `price` of `token` (address(0) = native S) until `expires`.
Nothing moves now; on a fill the marketplace moves the NFT from the signer using the approval the signer already gave.
On a fill the signer receives price minus the maker fee (a rate read from storage, up to 10%).
formats.shown: "List PUT pFT NFT #N" with the position, the price in its token and the expiry date.

findings.title: addListing: 'Price' does not say the seller gets the price minus the maker fee.
findings.evidence: pFTMarketplace.sol buy(): sellerAmount = listing.price - makerFee; descriptor addListing field label 'Price'.

findings.title: addListing: interpolatedIntent leaves out the price, which is the main term of the listing.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent 'List PUT {tokenId}'; price is only a field.

findings.title: addListing: an expiry of type(uint40).max means 'never', but it is shown as a far-future date.
findings.evidence: pFTMarketplace.sol addListing natspec: 'use type(uint40).max for never'; field 'Expires' format date.
findings.fix: No descriptor field can render it as 'Never'. The date shown is the value sent.

cases.notes: No asset moved. The reader correctly saw a listing of NFT #55 at 0.123 S.

formats.key: editListing(uint256 tokenId, address token, uint256 price, uint256 expires)
effects: Overwrites the payment token, price and expiry of the signer's existing listing for tokenId. This can also revive an expired listing.
Nothing moves now; on a fill the signer gets price minus the maker fee in the new token.
formats.shown: "Edit PUT pFT NFT #N" with the position, the new price in its token and the new expiry.

findings.title: editListing: 'Price' does not say the seller gets the price minus the maker fee.
findings.evidence: pFTMarketplace.sol buy(): sellerAmount = listing.price - makerFee; descriptor editListing field label 'Price'.
findings.fix: Label it 'New listing price (maker fee deducted)'.

findings.title: editListing: interpolatedIntent leaves out the new price and token.

cases.notes: No asset moved. The reader correctly saw the new price and expiry for NFT #8.

effects: Deletes the signer's listing for tokenId, so it can no longer be bought through the marketplace. No asset moves.
formats.shown: "Remove PUT pFT NFT #N" with the position.

formats.key: buy(uint256 tokenId, address expectedToken, uint256 expectedPrice, bytes32 expectedPutHash, (uint256 nonce, uint40 deadline, bytes signature) permit2Data)
effects: The signer pays the listing price plus the taker fee: price + price*takerFeeRate/10000.

With native S, msg.value must be at least price + taker fee, and any excess is refunded to the signer. With an ERC20, the contract pulls price + taker fee from the signer by transferFrom, or by a Permit2 transfer the signer signed.
The seller receives price minus the maker fee; the fee recipient receives both fees.
The signer receives pFT NFT tokenId from the seller.
formats.shown: "Buy PUT pFT NFT #N" with the position, the listing price in its token, and a permit deadline. Native value sent is not shown.

findings.title: buy: the signer pays price plus taker fee, but the screen shows only the price and no native value.
findings.evidence: Case 7: signer sent 0.123369 S (value 123369000000000000); screen 'Price' shows 0.123 S. pFTMarketplace.sol buy(): buyerPaymentAmount = listing.price + takerFee; require(msg.value >= buyerPaymentAmount). The function is payable and the descriptor has no @.value field.
findings.fix: Add an '@.value' field 'Total paid (incl. taker fee)' with format amount. Relabel 'Price' as 'Listing price (taker fee added)', because ERC20 buys also pull price + takerFee.

findings.title: buy: 'Permit deadline' shows 1970-01-01 when no Permit2 signature is used.
findings.evidence: Case 7 screen 'Permit deadline: 1970-01-01 00:00:00Z'; buy() ignores permit2Data when the signature is empty. The reader was unsure whether the transaction would fail.

findings.title: buy: the seller who gets paid comes from storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: pFTMarketplace.sol buy(): _distributeNativePayment(listing.seller, ...); the seller is not in calldata.
findings.fix: None. The NFT, token and price are bound by expected* checks.

cases.notes: The NFT #55 coming in is shown right. The S paid is shown as 0.123 S but was really 0.123369 S because of the taker fee, so the reader got the amount wrong.

formats.key: acceptBuyOffer((address buyer, address denominationToken, uint96 minAmountRemaining, uint96 minFt, uint96 minStrike, address paymentToken, uint96 price, uint256 nonce, uint40 deadline) offer, uint256 tokenId, bytes signature, bytes permit2Signature, uint256 permit2Nonce, bytes32 expectedPutHash)
effects: The signer's pFT NFT tokenId is transferred from the signer to offer.buyer.
The signer receives offer.price minus the maker fee in offer.paymentToken (an ERC20), paid by the buyer through Permit2.
Any listing the signer had for tokenId is deleted.
formats.shown: "Accept offer pFT NFT #N" with the position, the offer price in the payment token, the buyer, and the offer expiry.

findings.title: acceptBuyOffer: the seller gets the offer price minus the maker fee, but the full price is shown.
findings.evidence: pFTMarketplace.sol _processOfferPayment(): sellerAmount = offer.price - makerFee; safeTransfer(msg.sender, sellerAmount). The descriptor field 'Offer price' is offer.price.
findings.fix: Relabel as 'Offer price (maker fee deducted)' so the screen does not imply the full amount arrives.

findings.title: acceptBuyOffer: the intent does not say the NFT is sold and leaves the wallet.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent 'Accept FT PUT offer' and interpolatedIntent 'Accept offer {tokenId}'; the code calls _pFT.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, offer.buyer, tokenId).

findings.format: buy(uint256 tokenId, address expectedToken, uint256 expectedPrice, bytes32 expectedPutHash, (uint256 nonce, uint40 deadline, bytes signature) permit2Data)
findings.title: buy: the signer pays price plus taker fee, but the screen shows only the price and no native value.
findings.reason: For native listings the contract keeps price plus taker fee from the value sent, and refunds only the excess. The screen shows only `expectedPrice` (0.123 S) and no native value, so 0.000369 S more leaves the wallet than the screen says. This is a storage fee rate that changes the amount the signer pays, so the amount rule makes it critical.
findings.quote: pFTMarketplace.sol buy(): `uint256 buyerPaymentAmount = listing.price + takerFee;` / `require(msg.value >= buyerPaymentAmount, InsufficientPayment());`; `_distributeNativePayment` refunds only `msg.value - buyerPaymentAmount`. Descriptor buy format has no `@.value` field; case 7 screen shows 'Price' = '0.123 S' while the mined tx sends 123369000000000000 (0.123369 S) and signerNet is -0.123369 S.

findings.format: acceptBuyOffer((address buyer, address denominationToken, uint96 minAmountRemaining, uint96 minFt, uint96 minStrike, address paymentToken, uint96 price, uint256 nonce, uint40 deadline) offer, uint256 tokenId, bytes signature, bytes permit2Signature, uint256 permit2Nonce, bytes32 expectedPutHash)
findings.title: acceptBuyOffer: the seller gets the offer price minus the maker fee, but the full price is shown.
findings.reason: The signer is the seller (msg.sender), and they receive the offer price minus the maker fee. The rest goes to the fee recipient. The screen shows the full `offer.price` as the only amount and says nothing about a fee. The maker fee is not zero in practice: case 7 shows 0.1% taken. This matches the 'recipient receives the amount minus a fee; full amount shown' critical.
findings.quote: pFTMarketplace.sol _processOfferPayment(): `uint256 sellerAmount = offer.price - makerFee;` / `IERC20(offer.paymentToken).safeTransfer(msg.sender, sellerAmount);` with `IERC20(offer.paymentToken).safeTransfer(_feeRecipient, totalFee);`. Descriptor acceptBuyOffer field `offer.price` labelled 'Offer price' (tokenAmount), with no field or label about a fee.

findings.format: buy(uint256 tokenId, address expectedToken, uint256 expectedPrice, bytes32 expectedPutHash, (uint256 nonce, uint40 deadline, bytes signature) permit2Data)
findings.title: buy: the signer pays price plus taker fee, but the screen shows only the price and no native value.
findings.reason: The mined transaction debits 0.123369 S, while the screen shows only 0.123 S. Native payments fund the price plus taker fee; only excess above that total is refunded.
findings.quote: cases/7.json, buy: screen {"label":"Price","value":"0.123 S"}; mined.signerNet {"symbol":"S","amount":"-123369000000000000"}. pFTMarketplace.sol, buy: `uint256 buyerPaymentAmount = listing.price + takerFee;` and `require(msg.value >= buyerPaymentAmount, InsufficientPayment());`. _distributeNativePayment: `_safeTransferETH(seller, sellerAmount)` and `_safeTransferETH(feeRecipient, totalFee)`. descriptor.json, buy fields contain no @.value or fee disclosure.
